messages.subject: Histograms Error Cannot Open Connection
parts:
I have a simple app created with histograms on different tabs.
It works fine in R Studio.
When I published it to the web here http://c03575217.shinyapps.io/Test1 the histograms won't load.
As far as I can tell, the dataset is being uploaded correctly to the shinyapps.io

Any ideas?

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Histograms Error Cannot Open Connection
parts:
Two common causes for this error are:

1) Windows filenames are case-insensitive while Linux is case-sensitive; is it possible you didn't exactly match the case of your data file's path in your source code?
2) Absolute paths that work on your machine are not likely to work on Shinyapps, instead locate the file relative to your app's root dir and use a relative path.
